procedural_matters: GER 1291 stated that his hearing request is only a protest.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: Wind was approximately 8 knots, with small chop.
GER 254 on starboard tack and GER 1291 on port tack were sailing on converging courses towards the zone of last leeward mark (4p) before the finish.
2 GER 254 entered the zone overlapped inside of GER 1291.
4 GER 254 gybed to port and became overlapped to leeward of GER 1291 two boat lengths from mark 5 GER 254 rounded the mark to port close to it.
6 GER 1291 sailed to windward of mark 4p, lowered the gennaker, tacked, gybed and rounded mark 4p on the required side. 7 No boat took a penalty turn.
conclusions: GER 1291 kept clear of GER 254 as require by rule 11.
GER 1291 by sailing to windward of mark 4p has given room to round the mark to GER 254 as required by rule 18.2(a)(1).
